equality_rule: Symmetric difference <= 1 square metre is numerical equivalence only, not statistical-scope proof.
containment_rule: AEI outside parent <= 1 square metre within same municipal product; report exact outside area regardless.
cross_source_rule: Report all measured differences; no tuned percentage threshold establishes equality. Coordinate or cartographic accuracy is not inferred from decimal places.
repair_rule: Use sf st_make_valid only for invalid geometries, preserve raw, report area changes and feature IDs.
